# Native differential fixtures

These files contain authored synthetic data produced by **Designer 2025.1.2.165**,
original engine, via actual GUI runs on 2026-11-09. They were not generated by the
Python implementation. No business/customer data is included.

- `native_textinput.yxdb`: `examples/parity/branch_duplicates_unicode.yxmd`, node 1
  Output, native probe 0000, run `reports/parity/designer-fixed`.
- `native_join.yxdb`: `examples/parity/join_multiplicity.yxmd`, node 3 Join,
  native probe 0002, run `reports/parity/designer-join`.

See `docs/tools/evidence/2026-11-09` for hashes, full snapshots, comparisons and
the observed Designer messages. Schema/diagnostics limitations remain explicit;
matching these fixtures is record-level evidence for these cases only.

Install `.[parity]` to exercise YXDB reader tests. Pure snapshot and gap-gate tests
also run without that optional dependency.
